strings.zh: 虽然在商店里买不到,{NEWLINE}但元气块可以使{CLEAR}濒死的精灵完全复活！{SCROLL}不过ＰＰ点{NEWLINE}不会回复,这点要注意！
strings.en: You can’t buy a Max Revive in stores,{NEWLINE}but it fully revives a fainted Pokémon!{SCROLL}It won’t restore PP, though,{NEWLINE}so be careful!

strings.zh: 金色喷雾器能使弱小的{NEWLINE}精灵无法接近你。{SCROLL}是数种喷雾器中,{NEWLINE}持续时间最长的！
strings.en: Max Repel keeps weak Pokémon away{NEWLINE}from you. It’s the longest lasting of{CLEAR}the Repel sprays.

strings.zh: 您好,看您的训练师卡片,{NEWLINE}是从真新镇来的吧？{SCROLL}我这里有一份从城都地区寄来{CLEAR}给大木博士的包裹。{SCROLL}能麻烦您带给大木博士吗？{NEWLINE}谢谢了！
strings.en: Hello! Your Trainer Card says{NEWLINE}you’re from Pallet Town, right?{SCROLL}I have a parcel here from Johto{NEWLINE}addressed to Professor Oak.{SCROLL}Could you take it to{NEWLINE}him for me? Thank you!

strings.zh: 送包裹的事就拜托您了{NEWLINE}非常感谢！
strings.en: I’m counting on you to deliver{NEWLINE}that parcel. Thanks so much!

strings.zh: 最近我们商店经{NEWLINE}常有一只野生的皮卡丘光顾,{CLEAR}它今天又来我们店里偷东西了。{CLEAR}再这样下去,{CLEAR}店里的生意就不好做了。{SCROLL}看您是很厉害的训练家的样子,{NEWLINE}拜托您把它收服或赶走吧。{SCROLL}据我所知它总是出现在常磐市周边,{NEWLINE}只要你找找应该能找到。
strings.en: Lately a wild Pikachu keeps dropping by{NEWLINE}our store. It came in and stole from us{CLEAR}again today. If this keeps up, business{CLEAR}is going to suffer. You look like a{CLEAR}strong Trainer. Could you please catch{CLEAR}it or chase it off? As far as I know,{CLEAR}it’s always around Viridian City. If you{CLEAR}look, you should find it.
